old_description: Throughout her career, Helena has led and supported major multi-million-dollar telecom projects for service providers, engineering firms, construction teams, and government partners. She specializes in project management, RDOF and BEAD initiatives, permitting strategy, operational optimization, and cross-functional leadership, helping organizations strengthen partnerships, improve efficiency, and successfully bring complex infrastructure projects from concept to completion.
about:
Based in Southport, North Carolina, Southeastern Cable Contractors, Inc. has spent nearly two decades building a reputation as a veteran-led broadband construction partner serving cable multiple-system operators and network providers across the Southeast.

The company delivers turnkey telecom and utility construction services spanning aerial, underground, and micro-trenching installation; fiber and coaxial deployment; permitting and engineering; MDU and ISP builds; and full project management with warehouse and inventory logistics. It reports millions of feet of subsidy-funded broadband construction completed and more than 5,000 miles of fiber built for government programs such as BEAD and RDOF, supported by a 70 percent in-house W-2 crew model and a fleet representing millions of dollars in equipment investment.

Customers include leading cable MSOs, internet service providers, and public-sector agencies pursuing federal broadband subsidies. The firm has executed residential drops, large-scale commercial builds, and government-funded infrastructure projects across multiple Southeastern states, with a documented 99.4 percent post-inspection pass rate and the ability to stand up new market branches within 30 to 60 days.

Southeastern Cable positions itself as a single-point accountability partner that lets MSOs focus on their core business rather than contractor oversight. Its stated differentiators include high-performance crews equipped for difficult projects, OSHA-compliant safety programs with weekly training and daily job-hazard analysis, and a philosophy of reliable execution backed by hands-on leadership.
